mentions.name: PitchSlap
mentions.description: This web game uses LLMs for group ideation wrapped in a high-concept anime corporate parody style. Players create arenas (thematic problem statements), submit ideas to solve them, and vote on the best one with help of an avatar. It also offers battles (shorter, simpler versions of arenas) and showdowns (follow-ups where players flesh out the winning idea by answering questions and voting). Planned features include a credit-style economy played for 'slaps', a fully automated AI-driven gameplay mode with AI avatars, and RPG-style avatar attributes that influence pitch generation. Intended for hackathon ideation, evaluating business ideas, or playing around with models.
mentions.problem: The creators were sick of all things AI in their daily jobs and wanted a less serious, playful way to use LLMs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Me and a buddy of mine were sick of all things AI in our daily jobs, so we started to play around with different ways to use LLMs and landed on PitchSlap (https://pitchslap.gg).

You create arenas, which are thematic problem statements, submit ideas to solve it, and then vote on the best one, all with help of your avatar.
